# RenderCV

> RenderCV is a CV and resume generator: write the CV in YAML, and RenderCV typesets it with Typst into a PDF, along with PNG, SVG, Markdown, and HTML versions.

- [AI agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rendercv/rendercv-skill/main/skills/rendercv/SKILL.md): how to write, edit, and render a RenderCV CV, with links to the JSON Schema, the CLI reference, an example CV, and every theme's defaults.
- [User guide](https://docs.rendercv.com/user_guide/): installation, the YAML input structure, and how-to guides.
- [JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rendercv/rendercv/main/schema.json): every field of the YAML input, with types, defaults, and descriptions.
